summary.headline: Your community in Hyderabad
summary.oneParagraphVision: Bring 150 people together in Hyderabad for a modern, elegant community. Build the celebration around catering, venue, decor, with a practical budget and a clear path to the big day. Your chosen traditions and dietary needs guide the details; confirm these with your vendors. Requested essentials: skip fire permits.
keyRisks: Catering budget ₹222.773/guest is below typical ₹625–₹1,125 for metro cities — consider reducing guest count or increasing budget.
Review must-have requests against dietary restrictions and avoid items; Conflicting constraints: conflicting requests need a safe alternative.
assumptions: All prices are planning estimates; obtain written local quotes.
Confirm accessibility, food allergies and local permissions with your vendors.

ideas.title: Food Donation Partnership
ideas.description: Partner with a local food bank to donate surplus food. Plan portions carefully to minimize waste while ensuring enough for guests.

ideas.title: Inclusive Event Design
ideas.description: Ensure wheelchair access, sign language interpreter, large-print programs, sensory-friendly quiet zone, and dietary labels.

ideas.title: Live Chaat Counter
ideas.description: Interactive chaat station with pani puri, bhel, dahi puri, and sev puri — customizable toppings for each guest.
ideas.whyItFits: Supports your vegetarian dietary needs. Budget-friendly option.

ideas.title: Drone Photography
ideas.description: Aerial shots of the venue and group photos from above. Check local regulations and venue permissions.
ideas.whyItFits: Matches your modern vibe. Budget-friendly option.

ideas.title: Bollywood Night
ideas.description: Movie poster cutouts, marquee lights, red carpet, and a Bollywood music playlist for a filmy evening.
ideas.whyItFits: A popular choice for community celebrations in Hyderabad.

ideas.title: Photo Booth with Props
ideas.description: Set up a themed photo booth with fun props, instant print, and a digital gallery guests can access later.

ideas.title: Magic Show
ideas.description: A 30-45 minute magic show perfect for kids and family audiences. Book an experienced stage magician.

ideas.title: Balloon Arch & Sculpture
ideas.description: Professional balloon installations in theme colors. Budget-friendly yet impressive.

ideas.title: Seed Paper Thank You Cards
ideas.description: Plantable seed paper cards that guests can grow into wildflowers. Eco-friendly and meaningful.

ideas.title: Farm-to-Table Vegetarian Feast
ideas.description: Seasonal, locally-sourced vegetarian menu with creative presentations. Reduces carbon footprint and supports local farmers.
ideas.whyItFits: Supports your vegetarian dietary needs. Budget-friendly option.

ideas.title: Eco-Conscious Celebration
ideas.description: Potted plant centerpieces, seed paper invites, locally sourced food, reusable decor, and zero-waste goals.

ideas.title: Treasure Hunt for Kids
ideas.description: Age-appropriate treasure hunt with clues around the venue. Small prizes at each station keep kids engaged.
